title: docs(skills, mcp): teach that an AI service account is refused a confirmation-gated action whatever it sends
body:
security#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cx5nHfga3Hm9BzikGw

Filed by the security lane as the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #32926 (supersedes #32691). Priority and lane are triage's.

Blocked-by: #32926

## Why

The runtime rule (ADR-0151 D3 rule 3): an AI service account (an agent principal acting for itself,
no `onBehalfOf`) does not confirm an action for itself. An action declaring
`ai.requiresConfirmation: true` is refused `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` for such an account at every
action door (MCP `run_action`, `resume_run`, REST `/actions`, a host's `dispatchAction`), whatever the request
carries; a person runs that action instead.

Two published teaching texts still prescribe `confirm: true` as the retry for every caller, so an AI client
running under a service-account key is taught a retry that can never succeed:

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the `list_actions`, `run_action`, `resume_run` row of the MCP tool table
  ("refused with the same 428 unless the call sends `confirm: true` ... ask the human first, then retry").
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`, the `run_action` and `resume_run` entries
  ("Pass `confirm: true` on an action `list_actions` reports as `requiresConfirmation` ...";
  "including `confirm: true` for an action flagged `requiresConfirmation`").

## Acceptance

- Both texts keep the existing teaching for a person and a delegated agent (`confirm: true` after the human
  approves), and add one sentence: under an AI service account's own key the call is refused whatever it
  sends, and nothing runs; hand the action to a person (or the action's author declares
  `ai.requiresConfirmation: false` when it is safe unattended).
- The two texts say the same thing in the same terms.
- `skills/**` line ratchet: net growth paid by deleting content in the same file, no re-wrap counted as
  room (`check:skill-line-ratchet`); `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset; `@objectstack/mcp` patch
  changeset for `skill-md.ts`.
- `check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-refs` current; any `packages/mcp` test pinning the rendered text updated.
- No runtime change; no change to `delete_record` / `delete_records` teaching (a different gate).

Dedupe words: service account confirm, requiresConfirmation skill text, run_action confirm retry, ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED agent.
